$Comment: An easy delivery: a load of planks, handed back at the board. TURN_IN on '_Planks' with CONTAINS takes any species and any half-plank cut, and a contract is always handed back at the board that posted it, so there is no place to author. Weight 2 makes it twice as likely as an even rival for the same easy slot, which is how a staple contract stays common without crowding the band out. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Daily board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature gate in Requires is for a server where stations have been switched off: a board draws its slots without reading a contract's Requires, so the gate refuses at Accept rather than keeping the contract off the board.
